articles.title: Coldcard exploit could boost demand for regulated bitcoin exposure, analysts say
articles.snippet: Cantor sees positive read-through for crypto custody providers, while FRNT says the breach could drive some investors toward bitcoin ETFs.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows surge after Coldcard hack, but link is unclear: Bloomberg analyst
articles.snippet: A week-long streak of inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs has coincided with the Coldcard wallet exploit, fueling debate over whether some investors are shifting away from self-custody.

articles.title: Coldcard hackers transfer 64 BTC and 200 ETH to cryptocurrency mixers
articles.snippet: Hackers behind the Coldcard exploit transferred millions in digital assets to cryptocurrency mixers, while most stolen funds remained traceable in attacker-controlled wallets.

articles.title: Ledger Says Coldcard Exploit Shows Bitcoin Wallet Security Must Adapt to AI
articles.snippet: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet says the Coldcard exploit underscores why certified hardware randomness matters—and why AI is reshaping wallet security.

articles.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Exploit Explained: Entropy, How Keys Are Generated, and Why Bits Matter
articles.snippet: A flaw in Coldcard wallets cost Bitcoin holders more than $100 million—and reopened an old fight about whether you can trust dice.
